signals.thesis: Building on Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller's earlier warning that he would back a December rate increase—and potentially a 50-basis-point move if inflation accelerated—the U.S. Consumer Price Index rose a hotter-than-expected 0.4% in October against a 0.3% consensus forecast. The print and accompanying hawkish Fed commentary triggered the sharpest surge in short-term U.S. Treasury yields in 19 months, pushed the 10-year Treasury yield back to 5%, lifted Asian bond yields, and sent the Nasdaq down 1%.
signals.title: Hotter-than-expected 0.4% October CPI sparks 19-month spike in short-term yields and fuels December Fed hike bets

signals.thesis: Following earlier reports that Nvidia shares had edged higher as the board launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, the stock reversed course to slide for a second consecutive day. Nvidia has now hired law firm Wachtell Lipton to lead the probe into Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, a top executive at data center company Megaspeed whom U.S. officials allege is a Chinese spy.
signals.title: Nvidia hires Wachtell Lipton to lead CEO espionage probe as stock slides for a second day

signals.thesis: After facing intense debt-market scrutiny and bond yields above 16% amid fears of a data center slowdown, AI cloud provider CoreWeave beat third-quarter revenue expectations and raised its full-year outlook. The results sent CoreWeave shares up 13% and lifted broader U.S. tech stock futures as investors reassessed the durability of AI infrastructure demand.
signals.title: CoreWeave beats Q3 revenue and raises guidance, sending stock up 13% and lifting AI tech futures

signals.thesis: After earlier reports that Anthropic was preparing to push ahead with its listing below an initially discussed $1.5 trillion valuation, the AI lab set an IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share, targeting a valuation between $1.3 trillion and $1.4 trillion. The offering is scheduled to price on November 18 and begin trading on November 19, with seven company insiders each set to sell roughly $250 million in stock—valuing the founders' stakes at $18 billion apiece—while retaining total voting control.
signals.title: Anthropic sets $70–$78 IPO price range for $1.3T–$1.4T valuation Ahead of November 19 debut

signals.thesis: The U.K. competition regulator warned that Unilever Plc and McCormick & Co.'s $44.8 billion deal faces an in-depth antitrust investigation unless the companies offer remedies to resolve competition concerns.
signals.title: Unilever and McCormick's $44.8B deal faces in-depth U.K. antitrust investigation
